result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 3.13% (18.46% vs 15.33%).
Beat the benchmark in 71.2% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Large Cap.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.64 vs 0.50) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 2.55% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.75).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-37.44% vs -37.92%).
Rolling return range spans -27.43% to 93.80% (121.23 pp spread) — consistency score 83.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
